evidence: Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, bitcoinkernel.cpp, and bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h to expose a new script tracing interface in the libbitcoinkernel C/C++ API.
rationale: Exposes an optional script evaluation tracer through the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper to enable external debuggers, visualizers, and testing harnesses. Downstream consumers and reviewers confirmed its practical utility by demonstrating working prototypes against rust-bitcoinkernel.
